_comment: The status glossary + first-encounter surface, end to end. QA reality (see wandering_inn_game/CLAUDE.md Gotchas): combat_autoplay's melee-profile default NEVER casts a spell for the PC, and no canonical fight's autoplay path applies a status either -- so this is a NEW fixture script (near_mage_cast) driving a REAL hotbar cast by hand, same idiom as combat_move_input/relc_tutorial. Loads a mage-kitted PC standing next to Relc with met_relc already banked (so his 'meet' node offers the Spar option directly), spars the training dummies (relc_spar/training_yard -- zero blocked cells, an inert-AI target that never moves or attacks, so the exact cell math for frost_bolt's range 4 holds turn after turn with no risk). Proves: (1) journal Effects section is ABSENT before any status is ever seen (fresh boot); (2) casting frost_bolt at training_dummy_a applies slowed with status_applied.first_seen==true and the L1-generated glosary text riding the COMBAT FEED, not a toast -- traced: combat_hud.gd's readout panel (x[330,950] y[530,642]) overlaps message_layer's toast panel (x[808,1256] y[590,686]) and combat_screen's CanvasLayer is added to the tree AFTER message_layer's, so a toast fired mid-combat would render invisibly behind the opaque readout parchment; (3) a SECOND cast on the same fight/target still applies slowed (status_applied fires again) but NEVER re-fires first_seen -- the once-only property, proven structurally via assert_event_count rather than screenshot/OCR; (4) combat_autoplay finishes the fight (basic melee attacks only from here -- the frost_bolt proof is already banked) to VICTORY; (5) the post-victory journal now carries seen_statuses:['slowed'] in ui_journal_shown's payload and renders the Effects section with the exact WIEffectText.status_line text.

steps._comment: Move down to the 'Continue' row, confirm loads the near_mage_cast manual slot.

(1) Fresh boot, nothing ever seen: the journal's Effects section is omitted entirely (no 'None yet' filler) -- ui_journal_shown's seen_statuses payload is the structural proof; the screenshot is the visual confirmation the plan asks for.
steps.name: journal

steps._comment: Relc is right below, already met -- 'meet' node's visible options are ['What's out here worth guarding?', 'Got time to show me how to fight? (Spar)', 'Keep walking.'] (index 1 is the spar option).
steps.name: interact

steps._comment: SOCIAL PILLAR II PHASE C: first talk to Relc this waking now absorbs the rotating pool line (dialogue_line + chatted_with_<id> + heard_gossip banks); a second interact opens the real conversation.

payload_contains.speaker: Relc
payload_contains.text: Ha! Good instinct. Everybody swings wrong at the start. Might as well get it done here. Watch keeps training dummies in the gatehouse. I drag a couple out when gate duty gets slow. Don't ask about the wheels. Rules are you move and you hit. That's it. That's all the rules.

steps._comment: 'spar_offer' node: default cursor (0) is 'Ready when you are.' -- accept.
steps.name: confirm

steps._comment: quick_cast (ap_cost 0, a passive) and light (exploration-only context) never occupy a combat hotbar slot -- Attack, Dash, frost_bolt, End Turn = 4 (rebuild_slots' own filter: contexts has combat AND ap_cost>0).
(2) Move into frost_bolt's range-4 lane: (2,3) -> (3,3), chebyshev 4 to training_dummy_a at (7,3). training_yard has zero blocked cells, so LoS is clear regardless.
Slot 2 (key 3) is frost_bolt -- Attack(1)/Dash(2) are the fixed slots, then the mage kit in grant order (frost_bolt, quick_cast, light).
steps.name: hotbar_3

steps._comment: Default target is the lowest-hp-then-id enemy -- both dummies start at equal hp, so training_dummy_a (alphabetically first) is targeted with no cycle needed.
steps.name: confirm

steps._comment: (3) End turn, let the two inert dummies auto-end theirs (never acting), cycle back to the pc, and cast again on the SAME still-slowed-eligible target: the once-only property.
steps.name: end_turn

steps._comment: (4) The frost_bolt proof is banked; finish the fight with plain autoplay (melee-profile default -- 21 HP dummies, real kit, no risk).

(5) Post-victory journal: seen_statuses now carries slowed, and the Effects section renders the exact L1 glossary sentence. recent_count RE-DERIVED 23 -> 24 for GH#334 notes 19/28 (the HP half of the same disclosure, which fires for EVERY build and so lands one more feed line here on top of the MP one), and before that 22 -> 23 for v0.16.1 finding 19: this fixture's PC holds [Mage], so the new one-shot MP disclosure ('[Mana gathers fresh at every battle's start.]') fires at the start of this fight, and combat_hud.feed_push lands every feed line in Recent Messages by GH#170(b)'s standing contract. Measured against main on this exact seed: main's list is 22 entries, this run's is the same 22 plus that one line in slot 2. Nothing else moved -- in particular the fight's own two post-victory toasts land exactly where they did before (the Relc line records on its drain; 'Autosaved.' is housekeeping, is NOT mirrored into the combat feed, and is still mid-queue-drain when the journal pauses the drain, so it is outside the snapshot on both sides).
steps.name: journal
